eval_map_dataset: evaluate mean average precision of a detection dataset using det_results and annotations
calculate_average_precision: calculate average precision from recall and precision arrays using area or 11points mode
classify_tpfp_imagenet: classify detected bounding boxes as true or false positives using ImageNet IoU rules
classify_tpfp_default: classify detected bounding boxes as true or false positives using default IoU threshold matching
print_map_summary: print a formatted ASCII table summarizing mAP results per class with gts, dets, recall, and AP
